records.part: Purchase of Drone and C2 Apparatus to support UAS command and control (Spirit All-Weather Unmanned Aerial Vehicle and accessories/components and command and control vehicles)
records.reason: Volatus Aerospace is the only known company that manufactures and distributes the Spirit All- Weather Unmanned Aerial Vehicle and the necessary accessories/components and command and control vehicles for their operation. They are not available through any other third party vendor.
